**Mode:** full review of `be6e6da...HEAD`, read-only. No tests were run, nothing was changed and nothing was posted.

**Scope:** 1 commit (`53b0b10`, known-address dropdown for tx-builder), 10 files, +632 −50. The three-dot diff resolves to merge-base `0aa27af`.

**How far this went:**
- I ran the category passes myself instead of starting one agent per category. The diff is small and nearly all the logic is in one file.
- The two main findings were each checked by two independent agents, one trying to prove the finding and one trying to disprove it. All four agreed the findings are real.
- The two smaller findings were not independently checked.
- I did not compute a numeric score.

## Verdict: fix finding 1 before opening the PR; the rest can go in this PR or a follow-up

| # | Priority | Where | Finding | Checked |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P2 | `apps/tx-builder/src/components/forms/fields/AddressInput.tsx:106` | A contact's name stays visible after the address changes from outside | Confirmed by both agents |
| 2 | P3 | `apps/tx-builder/src/components/forms/fields/AddressInput.tsx:149` | Addresses set by the app are logged as "Address manually entered" | Confirmed by both agents |
| 3 | P3 | `apps/tx-builder/src/components/forms/fields/AddressInput.test.tsx:161` | The tests that change the address from outside don't check the name or the analytics | Not checked |
| 4 | P3 | `apps/tx-builder/src/hooks/useKnownAddresses.ts:33` | A failed or rejected address-book request stays empty for the whole session | Not checked |

### 1. A contact's name stays under a different or empty address (P2, bugs)

**What happens:**
- The name comes from `selectedName` (`AddressInput.tsx:53`) and is shown as helper text at `:222`.
- Picking a contact sets it at `:158`. The only thing that clears it is the user typing (`:188`).
- The effect at `:106-121` updates the input when the `address` prop changes from outside, but it never clears `selectedName`.

**Two ways to reach it today:**
- **After "Add transaction":** `SolidityForm.tsx:123-135` (`resetForm`) sets contract-method address parameters back to `''`. The field is not remounted, because its key only depends on `contractMethodIndex`, which is usually `'0'`. The old contact name stays under an empty field.
- **Proxy contracts on the Dashboard:** the user picks a contact that is a proxy, then confirms the implementation-ABI dialog. `Dashboard.tsx:189` sets the implementation address, but the proxy contact's name stays underneath it.

**Why it matters:** in a transaction builder, a contact name shown next to the wrong address is misleading. The actual values are still correct: the recipient stays the proxy, and an empty required field is caught by validation. The validator agent rated the impact as a recoverable UI confusion.

**Fix:** in the effect at `:106`, clear `selectedName` whenever the incoming address differs from the selected contact's address. Add a test: pick a contact, change `address` from outside, and assert the name is gone.

### 2. App-set addresses are logged as "Address manually entered" (P3, bugs/analytics)

**What happens:**
- The effect at `:146-152` is meant for network switches, but it runs whenever `inputValueRef.current !== address`.
- When a network prefix is shown, that is true after every change from outside: the input holds `eth:0x…` and the prop holds `0x…`.
- The effect then calls `updateAddressState`, which fires the event at `:137`.
- `lastTrackedAddressRef` is only set at mount, when typing, and on contact selection. The ENS path (`:80-96`) and the outside-change path (`:106-121`) never update it, so nothing stops the event.

**Result:** ENS resolutions, the proxy/implementation switch and batch-edit prefills are all counted as manual entries, which inflates the metric the feature is meant to measure.

**Fix:** set `lastTrackedAddressRef.current = checksumValidAddress(...)` in `resolveDomainName` and in the outside-change effect. Alternatively, make the effect at `:146` run only when `networkPrefix` actually changed.

### 3. Tests don't cover either defect (P3, testing)

The tests "updates the displayed value when the address changes from outside" (`:161`) and "resolves an ENS name" (`:190`) both use the vulnerable setup (`networkPrefix="eth"`). Neither asserts the helper text or `trackSafeAppEvent`. Adding those two assertions would have caught findings 1 and 2.

### 4. Failed address-book requests are cached for the session (P3, bugs)

`requestAddressBook().catch(() => [])` is stored in the module-level cache for the rest of the session. So these all leave the dropdown empty until the app reloads:
- the user dismisses the consent dialog;
- the request fails temporarily;
- a contact is added in Safe{Wallet} later.

Not re-prompting may be intentional. If it is, a short comment saying so would help. If not, only cache successful results.

## Ruled out
- **Picking the same contact twice does nothing** (MUI skips `onChange` when the value is unchanged): not a problem here. `knownAddresses` builds new option objects on every render, so the second pick is a different object and `onChange` still fires.
- **Enter no longer submits the form:** it still does. In `freeSolo` mode without `multiple`, Autocomplete doesn't call `preventDefault` on Enter unless an option is highlighted.
- **Dashboard's check-icon adornment is lost:** it is kept, because the `endAdornment` override at `:227` wins.
- **`lucide-react` as a new dependency:** it uses the same version as `apps/web` (`^0.563.0`), so it's consistent.

## Not checked
- I did not run any tests, and there are no `node_modules`. The MUI Autocomplete behaviour above comes from my knowledge of MUI v6, not from reading its source.
- I did not visually check the dropdown, the sticky group header or dark mode.
- The first time the dropdown opens, the host's permission dialog appears. The code comment says this is intended, and I did not assess the UX.

## Worth tidying
Nothing beyond the fixes above.
